message:
[K/N][CExport] Tests: pin declaration order of sibling modules (#8488)

`moduleDependencyOrder` only covers libraries related by a dependency
edge, where the reverse-topological rank from
KlibDAG.librariesReverseTopoSorted fully determines the order. That rank
cannot separate libraries no edge relates, so their order falls back to
what seeds the topological sort: the -Xinclude command line.

Add two fixtures over one diamond: a, b(a), c(a); They differ only in
whether b or c is included first.
Together they pin both halves of today's behaviour: a is emitted first
despite being included last, and siblings follow the command line. As a
pair they make that command-line dependence explicit, and any change to
it must show up as a diff in both goldens.

^KT-89632
